name: Veo
source:
"Field trip you say? Go by yourselves. I'll decide what to do on my own."

- Origin: Guf Confederation
- Birthday: Mid-October
- Height: 177cm
- Likes: Money, food stalls
- Dislikes: Group activities
- Will/Gem: "Lone Wolf Claws" Lone Onyx

The loner of Pegasus Class.
After finishing his academic curriculums alone, he wanders around to places unbeknownst to everyone.
